title: Built for professionals who manage labour compliance for multiple businesses.
description: Whether you work independently or as part of a growing consultancy, LabourFlow helps you manage clients, compliance, payroll, documents and team operations from one platform.

items.title: Labour Law Consultants
items.description: Manage multiple client companies, branches, employees, compliance deadlines, documents and statutory work from one organized workspace.

items.title: Labour Compliance Firms
items.description: Standardize client workflows, assign responsibilities and give your team clear visibility across compliance work, documents and deadlines.

items.title: Payroll & Statutory Consultants
items.description: Manage attendance, payroll calculations, PF, ESI, PT, LWF, payslips, statutory outputs and recurring client requirements in one workflow.

items.title: Multi-Client Consultancy Teams
items.description: Coordinate consultants and staff across a growing client portfolio with role-based access, task management, reminders and centralized records.
